messages:
alice: Heads-up — getting a spike of 'schema rejected' on /invoke/chat-route-B around 1718805400. Console shows many 400s but the samples are odd: tools returning `null` for required fields. Anyone looked into routing or the validator?

ben: Hmm. Do we have an example payload? can you paste one?

alice: Paste below (redacted):
```
{
  "tool": "code-runner",
  "result": null,
  "meta": {"duration_ms": 240}
}
```
This used to be a string. I think we recently rolled a model variant for route-B.

carlos: That looks like an adapter change. New variant returns a JSON object when it fails instead of a string. Validator expects `result: string`.

dana: Product question — are these rejects counting against customer quotas / billing? We had a user-reported spike in errors and they're worried about charges.

erik: Current billing pipeline increments tokens on request acceptance, but rejections may still bill the request pipeline tokens. Short answer: yes, some upstream token meters already saw the request. We should separate `validation_reject` as a distinct metric so billing can decide.

telemetry-bot: ALERT 1718805420: schema_reject_rate(route=chat-route-B)=8.3% (+6.1pp). Top op=invoke, top_tool=code-runner.

ben: Proposed flow: 1) Treat `schema_reject` as non-final in a soft-canary mode (log + WARN header). 2) If in canary, store sample to s3://redwood-samples/schema-failures/<route>/<ts>. 3) Expose metric `validator.outcome{route,tool,reason}`. Thoughts?

alice: I like soft-canary but worried about silent failures: apps expect structured tool output. Soft mode needs clear console UX and SDK flag so devs opt-in.

carlos: SDK already exposes `strict_tool_validation` toggles in the agent. We can default Hosted API to `strict=true` but allow Dedicated customers to opt softer during rollout.

dana: Console UX: add per-route "schema rejection" card next to latency/error cards. Allow filtering by `tool` and quick link to sample. Must have a quick rollback button on the route rollout page.

erik: Telemetry needs: counter `validator.reject`, histogram `validator.latency`, and sample export `validator.sample_id -> s3 path`. Also add tag `rollout_stage` so we can compare canary vs global.

ben: Implementation risk: if we log every sample we blow S3 quota. Suggest sample 1% of failures + deterministic sampling for reproducibility.

alice: Agreed. Also add a dashboard alert: if schema_reject_rate > 5% for 10m for any route -> page eng-platform on-call.

carlos: Small PR: update runtime adapter to coerce `null` -> "__NULL__" and let validator reject with reason `null-in-tool-result` to make debugging clearer. That reduces nondeterminism in logs.

dana: Decision summary?

ben: I’ll drive: (a) soft-canary toggle + SDK flag, (b) telemetry metrics + sampling, (c) console card + sample link, (d) billing note to Finance to not bill validation_reject/token events until we make a policy.

erik: I’ll add metrics and alert rule. I'll also add a small example query for the dashboard.

deploy-bot: deploy: canary update for route=chat-route-B, variant=v2 -> 5% traffic at 1718805700.

alice: Assigning tasks: @ben -> rollout plumbing, @erik -> metrics & alerts, @carlos -> adapter coercion PR, @dana -> UX card mockups. I'll follow up with a one-pager for Support. :thumbsup:

ben: Sounds good. Follow-ups in #eng-platform.
